trello.name: Sign Venue Contract and Confirm AV Package
trello.desc: Diego is responsible for getting the convention center contract through legal review and signed by the end of next week. He must also confirm in writing that the AV package includes recording in all three rooms (main hall plus two breakout rooms). Acceptance criteria: Signed contract and written AV confirmation by next week.

trello.name: Lock Speaker Lineup
trello.desc: Bo will send final follow-ups to the two 'maybe' speakers with a decision deadline of Friday. If either declines, he will select replacements from a backup list of five names. Bo must have the final lineup of nine speakers locked in two weeks to allow printing of the agenda. Acceptance criteria: Confirmed speaker list of nine by two weeks from now.

trello.name: Obtain Keynote Abstract
trello.desc: Bo will chase Dr. Osei for the keynote abstract within this week. The abstract is needed for the website and printed program. Acceptance criteria: Receipt of keynote abstract by end of week.

trello.name: Prepare and Execute Email Campaign
trello.desc: Diego will draft three waves of email campaigns this month: (1) agenda announcement sent the day the speaker lineup locks, (2) early-bird deadline reminder two weeks before the price change, and (3) a final-week registration push. The first email wave should go out on the day the agenda is live. Acceptance criteria: Drafted emails ready this month and timely sending of all campaign waves.

trello.name: Update Website Speaker Pages
trello.desc: Once the speaker lineup is locked, Bo will hand off speaker bios and headshots to Diego on the same day without delay. Diego will update the website speaker pages before the first email campaign wave is sent. Acceptance criteria: Updated speaker pages live before agenda announcement email.

trello.name: Review and Approve Swag Design Proofs
trello.desc: Camille will review the swag design proofs today in the shared drive. Upon approval, Diego will place the order for 800 shirts, 500 notebooks, and 1,000 stickers within this week. Lead time is six weeks. Acceptance criteria: Approved proofs and order placed this week.
